40	4. **Sanity gates (recording, not tuning).** hybrid must not underperform BOTH lexical and dense; shard_recall@N must beat a random-N-shards baseline. On failure: file the issue and stop — tuning belongs to M5–M11.

43	
44	1. `rg -l "data/sample|generate_sample_corpus"` returns no source/test/conf hits.
45	2. `kedro run --env prod --pipeline production` completes; index at 256 shards; document count in [190k, 200k].
46	3. Every docid in `miracl_en_dev_judgments.jsonl` exists in the built index (asserted in `validate_judgments`).
47	4. `kedro run --env prod --pipeline evaluation` writes `data/08_reporting/eval_report.json` with 4 modes × 5 metrics including shard_recall@N; no mode is all-zero/NaN.
48	5. `make test` passes fully offline using the committed real fixture slice.
